scope: Nineteen EvoEmo states selected because the existing cross-fitted MS policy was ON; RS was forced OFF in the routed arm and the original M0+R0 response was reused as baseline.

design_assessment.what_is_cleanly_isolated: The response-program contrast is MS-only versus M0+R0 on the selected ON slice, so it removes the prior RS response-act confound.
design_assessment.what_is_not_external: The 19 states come from the same 127-item labeled/OOF development pool and represent 11 independent users. This is a cross-fitted in-domain ON-slice ablation, not a fresh untouched external confirmation and not a full-policy comparison over ON and OFF states.
design_assessment.judge_limit: All quality and risk calls use one GPT-5.6 judge family. Position blinding is valid, but this is not multi-family or human-confirmed evidence.
design_assessment.baseline_reuse_condition: Baseline reuse is valid only for the exact frozen state, seed, generator and baseline prompt. It does not make the comparison concurrent and it does not remove provider nondeterminism.

mechanistic_split.interpretation: Most quality wins occurred when the generator declined to use the specific memory. The result therefore supports the total MS-treatment prompt/program on this slice, but it does not by itself show that recalling and using a specific past fact caused the benefit. Generator self-citation is telemetry and cannot replace independent Function review.

remaining_ms_pass_criteria.selector: PROMISING: cross-fitted BA=0.8121 on the current in-domain pool; external generalization remains unconfirmed.
remaining_ms_pass_criteria.candidate_support: SUPPORTED on the current real connected surface.
remaining_ms_pass_criteria.verified_function: OPEN: the prior 5/13 independent content-following result was measured in an RS-confounded response treatment; the current MS-only run has 6/19 generator-claimed uses but no independent source-aware Function review.
remaining_ms_pass_criteria.same_stack_outcome: PROMISING, not final: positive on the selected ON slice, but only 11 groups, one judge family, no full-policy OFF slice, and no fresh external confirmation.

stage_gate_interpretation: The 11-owner result passes a development-promotion gate because quality and risk directions are favorable and no critical risk was observed; p<0.05 is not required for a small development slice. It remains short of formal MS_pass because independent MS-only source-aware Function and fresh grouped confirmation are open.
next_scientific_action: Keep the current Llama generator frozen. Independently verify MS Function on the six clean claimed-use MS-only rows and matched safe-nonuse controls, then qualify the invariant R0-plus-MS-delta treatment on an outcome-blind development panel before any fresh grouped confirmation.
